LESSON: EARLY CIVILISATION ● ASIA, ● EUROPE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.2: Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is cultural heritage important to society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast
2. show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast
   In simple words: practise until you can describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world
   In simple words: practise until you can show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe in the examples.
2. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
4. Show that you can: describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Accommodate divergent opinions in groups as they discuss on the origin of early visitors to the East African Coast up to 1500,
2. Exhibit cultural awareness as they brainstorm on the Swahili civilisation along the East African coast and discuss factors that led to the growth of East African city states,
3. Digital literacy: Learners use digital technology to locate on a map of Europe and Asia, places of origin of early visitors to the East African Coast.
4. Learning to learn: Learners reflect on their own during role-play the best practices from early civilisations to the development of the modern world. Values:
5. Respect: Learners accommodate divergent opinions during group discussion on the origin of the early visitors in the East African Coast.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast
2. show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
